verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox lists check deposit as its own feature, but says it is offered only at "select locations". The pack gives no detail on how deposits are handled. Missing for 10: documented endorsement handling, confirmation of deposit to the customer's bank account, reconciliation or reporting, availability beyond select locations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, checks that arrive in the mail get deposited to my bank account by the provider — endorsed, deposited, and reconciled without the paper touching my hands
